senses.gloss: m. (צָמַם, sub. אזנים) [tied up,] a person whose auricles are a shapeless mass (instead of being carved out).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 4:15">Tosef. Bekh. IV, 15</cite> <cite ref="R00203"><he>צומים</he></cite>, expl.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 4:16">ib. 16</cite> <he>צ׳ שאזניו מגופפות</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>צומת שאזניה וכ׳</he>, corr. acc. <he>שאזניו</he>), v. <cite ref="C01211"><he>גָּפַף</he></cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:4">Bekh. VII, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Bekhorot 44a">44ᵃ</cite>) <cite ref="R00583"><he>צִמָּם</he></cite> (Bab. ed. <cite ref="R00203"><he>צומם</he></cite>; Ar. <cite ref="R00379"><he>צימם</he></cite>), expl. <he>שאזניו דומות לספוג</he> whose auricles resemble a sponge.
